sources.label: Crossfade between songs for the Spotify TV app on Fire TV (Morphe patches)
sources.author: Spotify TV Crossfade
patch_list: Crossfade between songs (0-12 s). Long-press Menu in the app to set the length.
Marks the app debuggable: enables run-as access to app files and WebView remote inspection.
Turns the Amazon Appstore (Kiwi) DRM lifecycle checks into no-ops so a re-signed APK runs.
